skill.description: Ordinary UTF8 string processing delegated to Rust str/String and pinned memchr; owned WIT results for slices and materialized iterators.
skill.name: wasmc-text

delta: Rust std str/String supply transforms, UTF8 conversion and iterator semantics; exact rustc identity is bound by the build receipt.
Thin WIT adapter owns substring results and materializes iterator results; allocation and transport quotas remain runtime limits.
UTF8 string find/rfind delegate to pinned memchr memmem with Rust-equivalent byte-offset and empty-pattern semantics.
upstream.name: memchr
unsupported: borrowed Rust lifetimes and iterator or closure ABI
full Rust std API, regex, Unicode normalization and grapheme segmentation
